title: 第11章 轮回山下第12章 狗东西
lines: 一剑扬起，轰然斩下！
叶寒气血爆发，元力沸腾。
“聚元境，不知死活！”李凯狠狠咬牙。
一把抓起身侧战剑，一道神力直接贯穿剑体，在千分之一个刹那，李凯举剑迎向了叶寒。
战剑碰撞，只一个照面，叶寒就感觉到强大的反震之力，身躯一颤，直接被震退三步。
李凯也不好受，身躯颤抖，双臂发麻。
他本就是仓皇应对，手中的战剑居然被叶寒的大力轰飞出去。
“再来！”
叶寒厉喝一声，他手中战剑直接丢弃。
唯双手凝聚成拳，扑杀而出，如猛虎现世，要撕碎猎物。
虎豹雷拳第一拳：猛虎出山！
战意、杀意、怒意……。
诸般一切凝聚一拳，双拳轰然砸下，竟带起一阵音爆。
拳至！
惨叫顿时响彻夜空。
李凯整个人被轰飞三丈开外，鲜血如柱！
“聚元九重，竟然能打出真空音爆？”李凯难以置信地看着叶寒。
纵然有贴身内甲守护，可李凯依旧五脏六腑翻江倒海，如同要从内部炸开，他的双臂骨骼寸寸碎裂，已经废了。
叶寒声音沙哑，喉中迸出两个字眼，一步一步走向前方。
体内元力几近枯竭，在刚才那悍然一拳中彻底消耗，但足够支撑他最后一击。
“我不想死，求求你，放过我……。”李凯惊慌失措，满脸恐惧。
砰！
拳落，狂暴力量透过内甲，李凯心脏炸裂，彻底咽气。
临死之前才知道求饶？迟了！
亲眼目睹李凯死掉，叶寒吐出一口浊气，顿时感觉四肢无力，体内空虚，直接坐倒在地上。
早在炎阳书院，他心中就已经宣判了李凯的死刑！
动身之前他强行将七十三枚二阶兽核的力量炼化至体内，就是在准备今夜的一战。
没有踏入神力境，强行炼化兽核，简直是找死的行径！
叶寒无法真正将兽核炼化，但却能凭借坚韧的筋骨、血肉，将那些兽核的力量强行封印到体内，若是再不出手，他的身躯都要被磅礴的元力撑爆。
好在这李凯终于死掉，叶寒目的达成。
“老师！”
目光转过，叶寒才看到莫轻柔不知何时已经掀开了马车的帘子，正在平静地目睹这一切。
“聚元九重，就想着和神力境一战，你太冒险了。”莫轻柔的眉宇间浮现一抹温柔。
“老师以后，没有人能欺负我们！”叶寒露出洁白的牙齿，笑容灿烂。
爬起身来，叶寒从李凯身上将那一块九阳火玉拿出，擦干表面的血迹，才是来到老师面前：“老师，给！”
看着莫轻柔将九阳火玉重新炼化、收起，整个人气色顿时好了许多，叶寒终于放心下来。
content_en:
The sword was raised and slashed down with a bang!
Ye Han's energy and blood exploded, and his energy boiled.
"Juyuan Realm, I don't know whether to live or die!" Li Kai gritted his teeth.
He grabbed the side sword and a divine power penetrated directly through the sword. In a thousandth of an instant, Li Kai raised his sword to face Ye Han.
The swords collided, and Ye Han felt a powerful counterattack in just one encounter. His body trembled and he was knocked back three steps.
Li Kai also felt uncomfortable, his body was shaking and his arms were numb.
He was responding hastily, but the battle sword in his hand was actually blown away by Ye Han's force.
"Come again!"
Ye Han gave a sharp shout and dropped the sword in his hand.
Only his hands condensed into fists, and he rushed out like a tiger appearing to tear its prey into pieces.
The first punch of the Tiger and Leopard Thunder Fist: The tiger comes out of the mountain!
The intention to fight, the intention to kill, the anger...
Everything was concentrated into one punch, and both fists slammed down, causing a sonic boom.
The punch arrives!
The screams suddenly echoed through the night sky.
Li Kai's whole body was blown away three feet away, and his blood was like a pillar!
"The ninth level of Juyuan can actually create a vacuum sonic boom?" Li Kai looked at Ye Han in disbelief.
Even though he was protected by personal armor, Li Kai's internal organs were still turbulent, as if they were about to explode from the inside. The bones of his arms were shattered inch by inch and were already useless.
"You, die!"
Ye Han's voice was hoarse, two words burst out from his throat, and he walked forward step by step.
The energy in his body was almost exhausted, completely consumed by the brazen punch just now, but it was enough to support his final blow.
"I don't want to die, please, let me go..." Li Kai panicked, his face full of fear.
Bang!
The punch fell, and the violent force penetrated the inner armor. Li Kai's heart exploded and he died completely.
Do you know how to beg for mercy before you die? Too late!
"Huh...!"
After witnessing Li Kai's death, Ye Han exhaled a breath of turbid air. He suddenly felt weak in his limbs and empty in his body, and sat down directly on the ground.
As early as in Yanyang Academy, he had already sentenced Li Kai to death in his heart!
Before leaving, he forcibly refined the power of seventy-three second-order beast cores into his body, just to prepare for tonight's battle.
Without stepping into the realm of divine power, forcibly refining the beast core is simply seeking death!
Ye Han couldn't really refine the beast cores, but he could use his tough muscles, bones, and flesh to forcibly seal the power of those beast cores into his body. If he didn't take action, his body would be exploded by the majestic energy.
Fortunately, Li Kai finally died and Ye Han's goal was achieved.
"Teacher!"
Turning his eyes, Ye Han saw that Mo Qingrou had opened the curtain of the carriage at some point and was watching all this calmly.
"Juyuan Ninth Level, just thinking about fighting against the divine power realm, you are taking too many risks." A touch of tenderness appeared on Mo Qingrou's eyebrows.
"Teacher, no one can bully us!" Ye Han showed his white teeth and smiled brightly.
After getting up, Ye Han took out the piece of Nine Yang Fire Jade from Li Kai, wiped the blood on the surface, and then came to the teacher: "Teacher, here it is!"
Seeing Mo Qingrou refining and putting away the Nine Yang Fire Jade, his whole complexion suddenly improved a lot, and Ye Han finally felt relieved.
